for(const proof of Object.values(manifest.pools).sort((a,b)=>Number(recoveredOwned.has(b.identity.baseMint))-Number(recoveredOwned.has(a.identity.baseMint)))){const id=proof.identity;if(Date.now()-id.chainBlockTime*1000<=7500000||recoveredOwned.has(id.baseMint)){watch.discover({signature:id.signature,feedMint:id.baseMint,receivedAt:Date.now()});watch.verify(id.signature,{mint:id.baseMint,pool:id.pool,migrationAt:id.chainBlockTime*1000,verifiedAt:Math.min(id.availableAt,Date.now())});record('pilot-watch-cached-identity-import',{mint:id.baseMint,at:Date.now(),historicalSourceAvailableAt:id.availableAt,previousLocalQueueWait:'unavailable; not inferred from proof age'});if(recoveredOwned.has(id.baseMint))watch.transition(id.baseMint,ledger.state().positions[id.baseMint]?'HELD':'ENTRY_PENDING','financial obligation recovered',Date.now());}}

const prunePoolProofs=()=>{const state=currentLedger.state(),at=Date.now(),retained=new Set(watch!.snapshot(at).rows.filter(r=>r.mint&&r.state!=='EXPIRED'&&r.state!=='PERMANENTLY_UNSUPPORTED').map(r=>r.mint!)),owned=new Set([...Object.keys(state.positions),...Object.values(state.pending).map(o=>o.mint),...candidates.keys()]);for(const [mint,proof]of Object.entries(manifest!.pools))if(!owned.has(mint)&&(!retained.has(mint)||at>=proof.identity.chainBlockTime*1000+7200000)){delete manifest!.pools[mint];record('pilot-pool-proof-cache-released',{mint,at,reason:'replaceable obsolete/unretained pool proof; financial history untouched'});}};prunePoolProofs();

const candidateReadyAt=(mint:string,at:number)=>{const c=candidates.get(mint),s=feeds?.snapshot(mint),age=c?at-c.proof.identity.chainBlockTime*1000:-1,ready=!!c&&age>=300000&&age<7200000&&!c.activationRefused&&!!s&&pilotCandidateWindowReady({...s,auditedThrough:c.auditedThrough,flowAt:c.flowAt,connected:feeds!.usage().pumpApiConnected},at),end=Math.floor(at/10000)*10000;if(!ready&&c&&!c.informationPending&&c.lastEvidenceRefusalWindow!==end){c.lastEvidenceRefusalWindow=end;record('pilot-entry-evidence-refusal',{mint,at,currentWindowEndAt:end,auditedThrough:c.auditedThrough,featureWindowEndAt:s?.windowEndAt??null,pending:s?.pending??null,hasQualityLoss:s?.hasQualityLoss??true,classification:'required data verification unavailable; not a predictive rejection'});}return ready;};

const retire=async(mint:string,reason:string)=>{const c=candidates.get(mint);if(!c)return;if(reason==='independent audit denominator unavailable')guard!.reject({mint,pool:c.proof.identity.pool},'POOL_HISTORY_WINDOW_TRUNCATED_CAPACITY_UNKNOWN',join('runs',runId,'events.ndjson'));const at=Date.now(),weak=['valid-window-currently-weak','valid-window-predictive-assessment-failed'].includes(reason),financial=currentLedger.state(),held=!!financial.positions[mint],owned=Object.values(financial.pending).some(o=>o.mint===mint);testedMints.delete(mint);if(!weak){lostCandidateWindows++;watchOutcomes.incompleteDataExclusions++;}const row=watch!.snapshot(at).rows.find(r=>r.mint===mint),priorCapacity=(row?.history??[]).filter(h=>h.state==='DEFERRED'&&pilotCandidateDeferral(h.reason,0).capacitySpecific).length,deferral=pilotCandidateDeferral(reason,priorCapacity);watch!.transition(mint,held?'HELD':owned?'ENTRY_PENDING':at>=c.proof.identity.chainBlockTime*1000+PILOT_CONTRACT.baseline.maximumAgeMs?'EXPIRED':'DEFERRED',reason,at,{deferUntil:at+deferral.delayMs});if(deferral.capacitySpecific)record('pilot-candidate-capacity-deferral',{mint,at,reason,priorCapacityFailures:priorCapacity,deferUntil:at+deferral.delayMs,awarenessRetained:true,freshFullWindowRequired:true,missedCoverage:'unknown executable opportunity; no inferred missed profit'});record('pilot-candidate-suspended',{mint,at:Date.now(),reason,coverageLost:!weak,awarenessRetained:true});await currentFeeds.removeCandidate(mint,reason,{waitForSettlement:false});if(!currentLedger.state().positions[mint]&&!Object.values(currentLedger.state().pending).some(o=>o.mint===mint)){trader.remove(mint);market.unregisterPool(mint);}candidates.delete(mint);};

const runway=pilotEligibilityRunway(id.chainBlockTime*1000,Date.now());if(!runway.allowed){testedMints.add(id.baseMint);reject('candidate-eligibility-window-unavailable',{mint:id.baseMint,runway,phase:'before-support-preparation'});return;}const phaseAt=Date.now(),opening=openingReserves(),phaseReadyAt=supportPreparationReadyAt(phaseAt);if(phaseReadyAt>phaseAt){deferPreparation(id.baseMint,'support phase plus opening capacity reserved before any support reads',phaseReadyAt);record('pilot-support-phase-deferred',{mint:id.baseMint,at:phaseAt,readyAt:phaseReadyAt,supportReads,openingReserves:opening,requestsStarted:0});return;}record('pilot-support-phase-admitted',{mint:id.baseMint,at:phaseAt,supportReads,openingReserves:opening,meaning:'phase headroom only; per-physical higher-priority admission still required'});market.registerPool({mint:id.baseMint,migrationSlot:id.slot,migrationVerified:true,evidence:proof.evidence});const costs=candidateOnly?await market.validateObservationPool(id.baseMint,new AbortController().signal):await market.prepareEntryCosts(id.baseMint,new AbortController().signal);if(!candidateOnly){need('depositLamports' in costs&&typeof costs.depositLamports==='string','PILOT_ENTRY_PLAN_REQUIRED');trader.setPilotEntryDeposit(costs.depositLamports,costs.evidence,id.baseMint);}

interpretation.naturalTradingPerformance: UNAVAILABLE; no trades or fills modeled or inferred by this study
interpretation.priceOnly: historical indexed USD close endpoints after verified on-chain migration; candle close is indicative, not fresh executable quote or guaranteed information-publication time
interpretation.syntheticControls: Only bin boundary assertions/earliest-window arithmetic; no synthetic P&L
interpretation.immediateRecommendedChange: Separate supported observation admission from baseline entry age. Observe/warm after verified identity/support when bounded capacity permits; leave actual entry age5–120min unchanged pending separate economic evidence.
interpretation.olderObservation: Bounded non-entry shadow monitoring for selected still-active older identities may collect missing2–6h/6–24h evidence; it does not authorize widening entry eligibility.
interpretation.keyBias: Verified complete candidate features are mostly late quiet selected windows; independently strong SI/FRONGUS moves already occurred within the existing5–120min age scope but lacked timely complete POE coverage.

limitations: No current index-created timestamp is used as a verified migration timestamp.
Historical migration origin is verified independently of current pool/token/fee support; each real decision still requires fresh support/state.
Closed60-second windows plus10-second alignment, confirmation/audit availability and five-second audit offset can delay first usable information beyond a nominal one-minute entry minimum.
Only3of10 independent indexed case histories may have retained creation proofs; actual count is reported above and no all-market age optimum follows.
Earlier/older unobserved flow is not reconstructed from OHLCV; no buyer counts/net buying/confirmation times are invented.
No hypothetical$50 quote pair is treated as an execution path or account P&L; SOL/USD changes remain separate from token-selection profit.
The assessed feature sample is not held out and contains repeated/overlapping windows; no optimization grid or independent trial count is asserted.
Structural source-gate inventory is current development code, not proof that every historical version used it.
The overload worktree is unadopted research and does not change age entry conditions.
